'''Gol Inacc''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who ran [[Inacc's Shipping]] at [[Estaria Central Starport]]. He owned and operated the freighter ''[[Inacc's Crate]]''.<ref name="HS" />
